fact: The author, writing for the OGP Results Report, says South Africa has national open government portals, Vulekamali, Municipal Money and GoMuni, that aggregate public data, and that more data is being published than ever; the document does not name the publishing body, and is dated 2026-07-27, which is used as as_of.

The City of Tshwane's mayor said its new Enterprise Data and Analytics Platform supports the continued development of the city's Open Data Portal; the document gives no dataset count and does not describe its contents (document published 2026-10-02, which is the date used).

fact: The National Treasury's Office of the Chief Procurement Officer publishes eTenders procurement data from February 2017 to September 2026 for download in JSON, Excel and CSV under the Open Data Commons PDDL licence, with 35,309 tenders and 9,551 awards.
Pollicy says South Africa's National Data Portal (data.gov.za), led by the Department of Public Service and Administration, is a government open data portal.

South Africa's National Treasury transparency portal offers monthly eTender procurement data from May 2021 for download in OCDS CSV, JSON and Excel under a Creative Commons BY 4.0 licence, with a JSON API.
South Africa's Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment offers free downloadable geospatial data on its EGIS page, with quarterly releases scheduled for 2026/27 and no licence stated.
The South African National Biodiversity Institute publishes its 2025 national species checklist (99,254 accepted names) for download under a CC-BY 4.0 licence.
